newsitem.title: UK: Two executives to join B.A.T board.
newsitem.headline: Two executives to join B.A.T board.

text.p: British tobacco and financial services group B.A.T Industries Plc said on Monday it had appointed insurance unit heads Martin Feinstein and Sandy Leitch to its board.

In a statement it said that Feinstein, president and chief excutive of Farmers Group, B.A.T's US insurance firm, would succeed Leo Denlea who will retire from the board on reaching 65 in March this year.

Leitch is chairman of the group's three main British financial services firms -- Allied Dunbar, insurer Eagle Star and Threadneedle Asset Management -- as well as chief executive of British American Financial Services Ltd.
